purpose: A presentation-variety layer that sits on top of the D4 house style without changing D4's rendering language. It supplies deterministic, per-hobby guidance across five dimensions (protagonist presentation, scene structure, lighting/palette, emotional mode, special-effect intensity) so that thousands of catalog cards do not converge on the same young-female / golden-hour / medium-shot / smiling / sparkly default. Selection is a stable hash of the hobby recipe id, so it is reproducible across regenerations, not random. A hobby_overrides_v1.json entry may set 'diversity_lock' to pin one or more dimensions when the hobby's own semantics require it; hobby-specific recognition/must_include requirements always take priority over this guidance if the two ever conflict.

values.male_led: If a person is the clear main subject, let them read as a male-presenting protagonist.
values.female_led: If a person is the clear main subject, let them read as a female-presenting protagonist.
values.mixed_group: If multiple people appear, mix genders and presentations naturally rather than defaulting to a single uniform type.
values.older_adult: If a person is the clear main subject, let them read as a mature or older adult rather than defaulting to a young adult.
values.younger_adult: If a person is the clear main subject, let them read as a younger adult, appropriate and non-sexualized.
values.object_led: Where the hobby recognition requirements allow it, let the hero object, tool, animal, or environment carry the composition, with any human figure secondary, partially visible, or background-scale rather than a dominant foreground face.

values.small_group: Favor a small-group moment (three to four people) rather than a solo portrait.
values.object_hero: Let the key object or piece of equipment itself be the hero of the frame, with any person secondary.
values.environment_hero: Let the environment or setting carry real visual weight alongside the subject, rather than a tight character-only portrait.
values.close_up_action: Use a closer, more intimate action framing than a standard medium shot.
values.medium_hero_shot: Use a classic medium hero shot.
values.wide_environmental_scene: Use a wider environmental framing that shows more of the surrounding space.

values.bright_daylight: Light the scene with bright, clear daylight.
values.soft_morning: Light the scene with soft early-morning light.
values.cool_daylight: Light the scene with cool, neutral daylight rather than warm golden tones.
values.golden_hour: Light the scene with warm golden-hour light.
values.blue_hour: Light the scene with the cool blue tones of dusk (blue hour).
values.evening_interior: Light the scene as a warm evening interior.
values.night_neon: Light the scene at night, with artificial or neon-like light accents where the setting realistically allows it.
values.warm_palette: Favor an overall warm color palette.
values.cool_palette: Favor an overall cool color palette.
values.mixed_complementary_palette: Use a mixed, complementary color palette rather than a single dominant hue family.

values.joy: The emotional mode should read as joyful and light.
values.concentration: The emotional mode should read as focused concentration rather than an open smile.
values.curiosity: The emotional mode should read as curious and inquisitive.
values.excitement: The emotional mode should read as excited and energized.
values.calm_satisfaction: The emotional mode should read as calm, satisfied contentment.
values.tension: The emotional mode should read as alert tension or suspense appropriate to the activity.
values.discovery: The emotional mode should read as a moment of discovery or realization.
values.mastery: The emotional mode should read as confident mastery and skill rather than a big grin.
values.friendship_connection: The emotional mode should read as warm friendship or connection between people.

values.none_minimal: Keep special-effect accents essentially absent: no sparkle trails, glints, or floating highlight particles.
values.subtle_highlights: Keep special-effect accents subtle: at most a few restrained highlights or small light glints, nothing showy.
values.moderate_sparkle_motion: Moderate sparkle and motion accents are welcome here to heighten the collectible feel.
